resolution.note: Session limit capped at 45 min below the token minimum; launcher mints with 50 min margin outside the lane class.

title: A lane session longer than the App token lifetime keeps GitHub access
body:
Why: #608 made the token helper cache-only inside lane sessions (KRN_SESSION_CLASS=lane); the cached App token expires after about 55 minutes while krn lane run allows 2 h, so a long session loses fetch access and fails as code, not infra.
Outcome: krn lane run refreshes the cached token outside the sandbox before it expires (or the session limit is capped below the token lifetime), and an expired-token failure is classed infra (69).
Proof: a test in test/cli/lane-run.test.ts with a fake clock shows a session past the token lifetime still reads a valid cached token.
